    field = []

    at_field_start = True
    i = 0
    n = len(line)

        if in_quotes:
            if char == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and line[i + 1] == '"':
                    field.append('"')
                    i += 2
                else:
                    in_quotes = False
                    i += 1

                at_field_start = False
                i += 1

                at_field_start = False
                i += 1

    fields.append(''.join(field))
    return fields
